title: Type x mizaj combos
caption:
Your type is how you think. Your mizaj is your fuel. Together, they explain everything.

A Safravi Mansooba-saaz has a five-year plan and a five-second fuse. A Balghami Muhafiz is already holding a warm shawl for you. A Damvi Mehfil ki Jaan is still dancing in the car park after the dholki. Find your combo on the slides.

Comment your type and your mizaj. Let's find the rarest combo in the comments.
